I Carry the Strength by Aleksandra Słyż

“My surname is pronounced ‘swish’,” explains composer Aleksandra Słyż. Ok, I was way off. “In Polish that means hearing,” she tells me. This is a perfect name for a sound artist who describes herself as ‘primarily concerned with the timbral relationships between acoustic and synthetic sounds and the exploration of microtonal tuning systems’.
